player_intro: posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in July 2001.
description: Oh Hell yeah, This thing went 0-3 in a tourney, just as expected of a deck with 52 chars, half of them being rebel troopers.
cards: posted: C-3PO, Dark Lord of My A$$
posted: C-3PO, Dark Lord of My A$$(Foil)
notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting (3): Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm, Careful Planning and Tatooine: Mos Eisley; these count toward the 60. No objective.
Byline 'Ghost "Ghetto 6" Face' reads as a joke name (Ghostface); credited by the DeckTech handle Ghetto 6 as plain text, as with decks 17930 and 17987.

The ten 'C-3PO, <nickname>' rows (Dark Lord of My A$$, its foil, Indian Chief, the masked one, Gangsta Btch, Afro Puff, Monkey Boy, Silver Surfer, Dominatrix, Wife Beater) are the poster's '3P0 Family' of custom-named copies; the strategy says all but Ben Kenobi, Careful Planning, Ardon 'Vapor' Crell and the foil Dark Lord were white-bordered (Premiere Unlimited), so each dested the only C-3PO card of the era, C-3PO (See-Threepio). Ten copies of a unique character is not a legal deck; kept as published.
Posted 'Tatooine Lars' Moisture Farm' dested the Light Premiere site Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (the draft had the Dark page).
The post says the deck went 0-3 at an unnamed tournament.
No Coruscant-set cards are listed, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
